html:
The Eperara Siapidara are an Indigenous people of the Pacific coast of Colombia, in Cauca and Nariño, with a small group across the border in Ecuador.

They speak a Chocoan language and are closely related to the Emberá and Wounaan. They live along rivers in the wet coastal forest, by farming plantains and maize, fishing and hunting, and moving by canoe. In recent decades armed groups and the drug trade have pushed many from their land. See also Emberá Eperara.
